## Author checklist

- [ ] Branch name and commits include the Jira key (e.g. `KAN-XX-short-description`)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria of the story are met
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated for the business logic
- [ ] Integration / BDD (Cucumber) tests added where the definition of done requires them
- [ ] CI is green (build, tests, SonarQube quality gate)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or personal data committed
- [ ] Documentation (README, reports, API docs) updated if needed

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Code is readable and follows the contributor guidelines
- [ ] Logic matches the story and its business rules (BR IDs)
- [ ] Tests cover the change, including boundary values and edge cases
- [ ] No new SonarQube issues or unreviewed security hotspots
- [ ] AI review findings checked; accepted/rejected findings recorded in the PR discussion (AI3)
- [ ] I can explain this change at a checkpoint
